name: GFT Technologies SE
summary: GFT Technologies SE, together with its subsidiaries, provides digital transformation services. It operates in two segments in the Americas, the UK & APAC; and Continental Europe. The company offers Wynxx, a GenAI powered software delivery, Smaragd, a regulatory compliance suite, and Engenion, a project portfolio management. It also provides services including AI services, AI consulting, data services, cloud services, software engineering, infrastructure and application management, and platform modernization.
